Admission Officer
Cabrini Hopetoun Rehabilitation
2-6 Hopetoun Street
Elsternwick
Vic 3185
24-07-2018
Dear Sir/ Madam,
RE: Julian McDonaldDOB: 12-01-1950
I am writing to refer Mr McDonal, a 68-year-old man, who is recovering from total knee replacement operation. Your further rehabilitation care would be appreciated.
Mr McDonald is a smoker and alcoholic. He has been suffering from osteoarthritis, gout, Hypertension, Hypercholesteramia and obesity (BMI:35) for many years.
On 20-07-2018, Dr Mossley performed an elective left knee joint replacement for him. Prominent post-operative pain was recorded. Accordingly, he was managed with morphine PCA, ketamine infusion and amitriptyline. Furthermore, he suffered from somnolence, snoring and agitation. Later, he was able to mobilize slowly due to pain.
Mr McDonald's management plan will include a proper rehabilitation program with a physiotherapiest and an occupational therapiest. A follow-up visit was scheduled on 07-09-2018. It is worth mentioning that he will need sleep studies for his obstructive sleep apnea.
In view of the above, I would be grateful if you could take over Mr McDonald's care and provide further management of his case including assessment of the returning to his caravan.
Should you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Doctor
